headline: Tragedy in Rajbari: 2-year-old child drowns in canal near home
summary: The child, named Aryan, fell into a canal used for soaking jute in the Puran Khalkula area of Baliakandi Upazila.
details: A two-and-a-half-year-old child named Aryan died after falling into a canal near his home in Baliakandi, Rajbari on Wednesday.
The incident occurred between 3:00 PM and 3:30 PM in the Puran Khalkula area of Islampur Union.
Local residents reported that Aryan fell into the canal, which was being used for soaking jute, while his family members were unaware.
After failing to find the child, family members searched the surrounding area and eventually found him dead in the water.
Baliakandi Police Station Officer-in-Charge (OC) Abdur Rob Talukdar confirmed the death by drowning and stated that further proceedings are underway.

headline_marked: Two cousins [[drown in pond]] in Gobindaganj; family mourns
headline: Two cousins drown in pond in Gobindaganj; family mourns
summary: A tragic incident in Gaibandha's Gobindaganj saw two young cousins, aged 3, lose their lives after falling into a pond while playing. The community is in shock.
details: Two children, Mim Akter (3) and Afrin Akter, drowned in a pond in Dashlal village of Shakhahar Union, Gobindaganj Upazila, Gaibandha. The incident occurred on Wednesday (September 30) around 11 AM.

Mim Akter was the three-year-old daughter of Farhad Ali from Dashlal village. Afrin Akter, her cousin, was visiting from Delduar, Tangail, with her father Kabir Mondal. The two girls were playing together near the house.

The children reportedly fell into the pond adjacent to their house unnoticed by family members. After a prolonged absence, relatives began searching for them and eventually recovered both their bodies from the pond.

The tragic deaths of the two children, who were playing together, have cast a shadow of grief over their families and relatives. An unnatural death (UD) case has been filed at the police station, according to Inspector Md. Zahurul Haque of Bairagihat Police Investigation Center.
